title: hussain kehte hai rokar mere ali akbar
body:
Hussain kahte hai ro kar mere ali akbar
Mere jawaa'n mere dilbar mere ali akbar
1.qushi ke ansoo na rukte tere khad o sin par
Hai baap ke tu barabar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
2.mai kaise dunga ijazat batao aye beta
Tu hai shabi e payamber mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Diya hai izne weqa aur kaha ye akbar se
Zaroor dekho palat kar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Tere biyaah ka armaa'n bohot hai sugra ko
Hai muntazar teri qaahar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
5.baghair tere na zinda rahunga ek pal bhi
Tu hai jawaa'n mere dilbar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Sawaal karliya kaisa hussain se tu ne
Nahi hai paani mayassar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Tere firaaq ne chini hussain ki aankhe
Hussain khaata hai thokar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Zayeef baap ke aage jawaa ne dam toda
Hai barchi seene ke andar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Jawan bete ka lasha hussain laate hai
Pukari laila tadapkar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
10.Tere firaaq me shabbir hogaya tanha
Bataao kya karu jeekar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
11.Tumhare baad mai kitna jiyu ga aye beta
Juda karenge mera sar mere ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
12.Dua ye karte hai ammar naseraan e aza
Bulalo aap ke dar par mere ali akbar
